biological_reference.closest_mechanism: hippocampal forward/reverse SWR replay for prospective/retrospective evaluation (Shin, Tang & Jadhav 2019, Neuron); reverse replay at trajectory completion (Foster & Wilson 2006, Nature); experience-biased sleep replay prioritization (Huelin Gorriz et al. 2023, Nat Commun)
biological_reference.divergence: 244b uses a fixed 50/30/20 forward/reverse/random mixture for the whole consolidation window; Shin 2019 shows the biological ratio is scheduled (reverse-dominant early, forward-dominant late), not a static blend -- likely understates the achievable effect size relative to a schedule-faithful implementation

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: Non-degenerate PASS -- corrects 244a's silent no-op bug (theta_buffer wiped before consolidation; FORWARD byte-identical to NO_REPLAY). All 4 harness-integrity preconditions genuinely met: reverse replay fires (9-23/seed), FORWARD now measurably diverges from NO_REPLAY (up to 0.046, vs 244a's 1e-13), production call path exercised. However, the confirmed effect is small and only weakly seed-robust: BALANCED beats FORWARD by a mean of +0.0083 against a between-seed SD of 0.128 (Cohen's-d ~0.065), in 4/5 seeds with 3 of those 4 margins under 0.012 and the dissenting seed reversing by a comparable magnitude (binomial P(>=4/5 wins | H0 no effect) ~0.19, not significant at conventional thresholds; no formal significance test is computed in the driver). BALANCED does not clearly outperform NO_REPLAY (+0.0015 mean, wins only 2/5 seeds) -- the demonstrated effect is specifically 'balanced replay recovers most of the deficit forward-only replay introduces relative to doing nothing,' matching the claim's own BALANCED-vs-FORWARD operationalization, not a general 'replay improves retention' finding. Treat as real, directionally-correct, biologically-grounded support at modest statistical strength -- not yet the 'significantly higher' result the claim's CONFIRMING text describes. A confirmatory follow-up with more seeds, a formal significance test, and RNG-stream isolation between replay-selection sampling and policy-action sampling would strengthen this considerably.
learning_extracted: 244a's driver bug (final-flush agent.reset() before the hand-rolled SWS loop) is now confirmed fixed by direct data comparison: NO_REPLAY/FORWARD_REPLAY were byte-identical to 17 sig figs in 244a, genuinely divergent (up to 0.046) in 244b

The 4 non-degeneracy preconditions this driver checks certify that the harness exercises the mechanism, not that the resulting effect is large or statistically robust -- these are separate bars and the manifest's single interpretation label conflates them

The claim's own pre-registered CONFIRMING criterion is BALANCED-vs-FORWARD only, not BALANCED-vs-NO_REPLAY; the run legitimately clears that letter, but FORWARD_REPLAY underperforming NO_REPLAY (-0.0068 mean) means the practically meaningful comparison (does any replay help vs none) is not established here

Possible uncontrolled confound: diverse_replay's mode selection and content sampling draw torch.multinomial from what appears to be a single shared global RNG stream, so conditions that call _do_replay a different number of times consume different amounts of that stream before Phase 2 -- not verified to be inert to Phase-2 action sampling
